eligibility.quote: When I send a request containing LLA, I expect to receive a response containing LLA too in order to compare it and ensure that global_origin has been successfully set.
eligibility.reason: The client and MAVROS exchange an origin and confirmation across topics. E1/E4 are supported by the concrete report, publishing code and maintainer-accepted fix. Wrong coordinate values cross the boundary, so a provider-only edit is not an internal-only defect. PAIR is supported.

failed_conditions.quote: Then FCU confirms this with GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN message containing the same coordinates as LLA. But plugin transforms it to ECEF and sends to topic `mavros/global_position/gp_origin`.
failed_conditions.reason: The nominal GeoPointStamped type is unchanged; its geographic position fields are overwritten with a Cartesian coordinate representation. The issue's Forward call explicitly uses latitude, longitude and altitude as both input and output, supporting all listed fields and the gp_origin topic.

loudness.quote: I just ran into this as well and agree that it is very confusing and probably wrong to use ECEF in a `GeoPoint`.
loudness.reason: Users observe semantically wrong delivered data, without a compatibility diagnostic in the report.

detection_stage.quote: Then FCU confirms this with GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN message containing the same coordinates as LLA. But plugin transforms it to ECEF and sends to topic `mavros/global_position/gp_origin`.
detection_stage.reason: The mismatch is observed in the runtime request/confirmation exchange.

resolution.quote: This PR removes such conversion matching message requirements and message contents.
resolution.reason: The diff removes the ECEF conversion, but the discussion does not identify a working resolved pair with the reporter's client revision. recommended is supported.

notes: Reviewed issue discussion and PR 1942 including its diff.
